candidate_authority.population: all note_on events with velocity > 0 in the MIDI track named Bass while GM program 33 is active
candidate_authority.forbidden_interpretation: candidate events are not relabelled as Contrabass

timestamp_extraction.method: accumulate delta ticks independently per track; accept note_on velocity > 0 on track Bass under active program 33; convert absolute ticks with 480 ticks/beat and constant 500000 microseconds/beat
timestamp_extraction.ordering: onset fraction, track index, native message index

matching.framework: exact frozen CED-VAL-006 one-to-one temporal Voronoi-cell assignment
matching.cells: half-open original-event Voronoi cells [left,right), bounded by 0 and 11912868/48000 seconds
matching.assignment: for each original in time order choose an unused in-cell candidate by minimum absolute displacement, then earlier candidate time, then lower native index
matching.tolerance_authority: original-event Voronoi cells; no additional tolerance and no accommodation for the YourMT3 10 ms lattice

metrics: population counts, densities, and temporal coverage
median absolute displacement, timing RMSE, and maximum displacement
matched-original partition counts across BOTH, HTDEMUCS_FT_ONLY, RX_ONLY, NEITHER

decision_gates_in_priority_order.gate: any authority checksum/count/schema invariant or byte-identical two-execution replay requirement fails
YourMT3 F1 and recall are each >= htdemucs_ft; median absolute displacement and RMSE are each <= htdemucs_ft; and NEITHER recovery count >= 22
NEITHER recovery count >= 22 (the frozen complementarity material-count threshold), global median absolute displacement <= 0.050 s, and global RMSE <= 0.100 s, while CLEAR_IMPROVEMENT is not met
YourMT3 F1 and recall are each < htdemucs_ft; median absolute displacement and RMSE are each > htdemucs_ft; and NEITHER recovery count < 22

firewall: oracle union is explanatory only; no Ground-Truth-driven production selector; no inference rerun; no MIDI, authority, JGA, Demucs, or RX modification
